summary: Investigated the upstream `navigateTree` API in `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`, then began integrating session-tree branching into both the real agent server and the fake client. Added an optional `navigateTree` declaration to `pi-agent-types.ts`, wired `branchTo` in `session-operations.ts` to call it (falling back to `manager.branch`), and extended the fake client's `FakeSession` state with `treeEntries`, `messageById`, and `leafId` fields.
decisions: If the underlying session exposes `navigateTree`, call it and short-circuit the branch operation when it reports `cancelled`; otherwise fall back to `manager.branch(entryId)`.
Make `navigateTree` an optional method on the `PiSessionLike` interface rather than requiring it.

Extend the fake client's session state to keep a parallel `treeEntries: SessionTreeEntry[]` plus a `messageById` lookup and a nullable `leafId`, rather than deriving branches solely from the existing `messages` array.
